[scriptable, uuid(dcace7e1-9600-47ba-a27e-b3bc8222192a)]
interface calITimezoneDatabase : nsISupports
{
    /**
     * The version of the IANA Time Zone Database provided.
     */
    readonly attribute AUTF8String version;

    /**
     * Get all supported canonical timezone IDs.
     *
     * This method is intended to provide a listing of timezones a user may
     * select in the interface. As such, it does not contain link timezones and
     * should not be used to restrict the list of valid timezone IDs.
     *

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: TimezoneDatabase requests canonical ICU IDs to avoid redundant choices in user-facing lists. Its IDL explicitly says that this list is not restrictive. CalTimezoneService can separately resolve an ID that is not already in its cache. Do not reject an imported timezone only because it is absent from the canonical picker list. The current Windows-to-IANA conversion is later comparison context, not another fully studied chronological landing. These paths were inspected statically. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Canonical timezone IDs are a picker list, not a validation whitelist
